# Bruno import fixtures

- `shop/`: a small hand-written `.bru` collection covering what the importer maps (login token flow with
  `vars:post-response`, assertions, inherited auth, multipart files, GraphQL, unsupported auth).
- `testbench/` and `yml-collection/`: copied from Bruno's own test collections
  (<https://github.com/usebruno/bruno>, `packages/bruno-tests`, MIT License, Copyright (c) Anoop M D and
  contributors). Only `.bru`/`.yml` files and `bruno.json` were copied.
